examples.en: April Fools' Day is on the first of April.
The announcer began a special news bulletin.
examples.zh: 播音员开始播报特别新闻。

examples.en: The television announcer told the story.
examples.zh: 电视播音员讲述了这个故事。
卡拉布里亚种植通心粉。

examples.en: Two of the leading growers spoke to the viewers.
examples.zh: 两位主要的种植者对着观众讲话。

examples.en: The growers were expecting a splendid crop.
examples.zh: 种植者们预计会有好收成。

examples.en: They were expecting a splendid crop.
examples.zh: 他们预计会有极好的收成。

examples.en: The villagers gathered the crop day and night.
The harvest began earlier than usual.
They cut three cartloads of macaroni stalks.
examples.zh: 他们割了三车通心粉茎秆。

examples.en: The crop is processed in the local factory.
examples.zh: 庄稼在当地的工厂加工。

examples.en: The announcer went back to the studio.
Calabria is a region in Italy.
examples.zh: 卡拉布里亚是意大利的一个地区。

examples.en: Signor Fratelli has won every year since 1991.
examples.zh: 弗拉泰利先生自1991年以来每年获胜。

sentences.en: He told the viewers that macaroni had been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
sentences.zh: 他告诉观众，这个地区种植通心粉已经有六百多年了。

sentences.en: Two workers had just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
sentences.zh: 两名工人刚刚割完了三车金黄色的通心粉茎秆。

sentences.en: The whole village had been working day and night gathering and threshing the crop.
sentences.zh: 全村人日夜不停地收割、脱粒。

sentences.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, had won it every year since 1991.
sentences.zh: 现任冠军弗拉泰利先生自1991年以来每年都赢得比赛。

sentences.en: It was April Fools' Day, and the whole story was just a joke!
sentences.zh: 那天是愚人节，整个故事只是一个玩笑！

article.en: 'We are going over to the macaroni fields of Calabria,' said the television announcer.
article.zh: '我们现在到卡拉布里亚的通心粉田去。'电视播音员说。

article.en: He told the viewers that macaroni had been grown in this area for over six hundred years.
article.zh: 他告诉观众，这个地区种植通心粉已经有六百多年了。

article.en: Two of the leading growers said that they were expecting a splendid crop that year.
article.zh: 两位主要的种植者说，他们预计当年会有一个极好的收成。

article.en: Two workers had just finished cutting three cartloads of golden brown macaroni stalks.
article.zh: 两名工人刚刚割完了三车金黄色的通心粉茎秆。

article.en: The whole village had been working day and night gathering and threshing the crop.
article.zh: 全村人日夜不停地收割、脱粒。

article.en: The announcer also showed Mrs Brabante, who had been helping her husband for thirty years.
article.zh: 播音员还介绍了布拉班特太太，她帮助丈夫干活已有30年了。

article.en: The last scene showed the famous Calabrian macaroni-eating competition.
article.zh: 最后一个镜头是著名的卡拉布里亚通心粉吃面比赛。

article.en: Signor Fratelli, the present champion, had won it every year since 1991.
article.zh: 现任冠军弗拉泰利先生自1991年以来每年都赢得比赛。

article.en: 'And that ends our special bulletin for today,' said the announcer.
article.zh: '今天的特别新闻节目到此结束。'播音员说。

article.en: It was April Fools' Day, and the whole story was just a joke!
article.zh: 那天是愚人节，整个故事只是一个玩笑！
